<?php

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Information\ExcelError;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Coordinate;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper;

class FunctionPrefix
{
    const XLFNREGEXP = '/(?:_xlfn\.)?((?:_xlws\.)?\b('
        // functions added with Excel 2010
        . 'beta[.]dist'
        . '|beta[.]inv'
        . '|binom[.]dist'
        . '|binom[.]inv'
        . '|ceiling[.]precise'
        . '|chisq[.]dist'
        . '|chisq[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|chisq[.]inv'

        . '|rank[.]avg'

        . '|stdev[.]s'
        . '|t[.]dist'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|t[.]inv'
        . '|t[.]inv[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]test'
        . '|var[.]p'
        . '|var[.]s'
        . '|weibull[.]dist'
        . '|z[.]test'
        // functions added with Excel 2013
        . '|acot'
        . '|acoth'
        . '|arabic'
        . '|averageifs'
        . '|binom[.]dist[.]range'
        . '|bitand'
        . '|bitlshift'
        . '|bitor'
        . '|bitrshift'
        . '|bitxor'
        . '|ceiling[.]math'
        . '|combina'
        . '|cot'
        . '|coth'
        . '|csc'
        . '|csch'
        . '|days'
        . '|dbcs'
        . '|decimal'
        . '|encodeurl'
        . '|filterxml'
        . '|floor[.]math'
        . '|formulatext'
        . '|gamma'
        . '|gauss'
        . '|ifna'
        . '|imcosh'
        . '|imcot'
        . '|imcsc'
        . '|imcsch'
        . '|imsec'
        . '|imsech'
        . '|imsinh'
        . '|imtan'
        . '|isformula'
        . '|iso[.]ceiling'
        . '|isoweeknum'
        . '|munit'

        . '|webservice'
        . '|xor'
        // functions added with Excel 2016
        . '|forecast[.]et2'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]confint'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]seasonality'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]stat'
        . '|forecast[.]linear'
        . '|switch'
        // functions added with Excel 2019
        . '|concat'
        . '|ifs'
        . '|maxifs'
        . '|minifs'
        . '|sumifs'
        . '|textjoin'
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . '|anchorarray'
        . '|arraytotext'
        . '|bycol'
        . '|byrow'
        . '|call'
        . '|choosecols'
        . '|chooserows'
        . '|drop'
        . '|expand'
        . '|filter'
        . '|hstack'
        . '|isomitted'
        . '|lambda'
        . '|let'
        . '|makearray'
        . '|map'
        . '|randarray'
        . '|reduce'
        . '|register[.]id'
        . '|scan'
        . '|sequence'
        . '|single'
        . '|sort'
        . '|sortby'
        . '|take'
        . '|textafter'
        . '|textbefore'
        . '|textjoin'
        . '|textsplit'
        . '|tocol'
        . '|torow'
        . '|unique'
        . '|valuetotext'
        . '|vstack'
        . '|wrapcols'
        . '|wraprows'
        . '|xlookup'
        . '|xmatch'
        . '))\s*\(/Umui';

    const XLWSREGEXP = '/(?<!_xlws\.)('
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . 'filter'
        . '|sort'
        . ')\s*\(/mui';

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlfnPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLFNREGEXP, '_xlfn.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlws. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlwsPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLWSREGEXP, '_xlws.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        $workingFormula = $functionString;
        $hadLeadingEquals = false;
        if ($workingFormula !== '') {
            if (str_starts_with($workingFormula, '=')) {
                $hadLeadingEquals = true;
                $workingFormula = substr($workingFormula, 1);
            }
        }

        $parsedTokenCount = 0;
        $parsedFormulaText = '';
        try {
            $formulaParser = new FormulaParser('=' . $workingFormula);
            $parsedTokenCount = $formulaParser->getTokenCount();
            $parsedFormulaText = $formulaParser->getFormula();
        } catch (\Throwable $parserException) {
            $parsedTokenCount = 0;
            $parsedFormulaText = '';
        }
        if ($parsedTokenCount > 0) {
            if ($parsedFormulaText !== '') {
                if (str_starts_with($parsedFormulaText, '=')) {
                    $normalizedFromParser = substr($parsedFormulaText, 1);
                    if ($normalizedFromParser === $workingFormula) {
                        $workingFormula = $normalizedFromParser;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $characterCount = StringHelper::countCharacters($workingFormula);
        $formulaAsReference = '';
        if ($characterCount > 0) {
            try {
                if (!Coordinate::coordinateIsRange($workingFormula)) {
                    $formulaAsReference = Coordinate::absoluteCoordinate($workingFormula);
                } else {
                    Coordinate::splitRange($workingFormula);
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $referenceException) {
                $formulaAsReference = '';
            }
        }
        $errorLookup = [];
        foreach (ExcelError::ERROR_CODES as $errorKey => $errorCode) {
            if (is_string($errorCode)) {
                if ($errorCode !== '') {
                    $upperErrorCode = StringHelper::strToUpper($errorCode);
                    $errorLookup[$upperErrorCode] = $errorKey;
                }
            }
        }

        $byteLength = strlen($workingFormula);
        $quotedBytes = [];
